review_evidence: README explicitly separates a Proofs section and lists alternating-player, cell-marking, board-distribution, winner and draw invariants proved in TicTacToe/Basic.lean.

A complete scan of its five Lean files found 25 theorem/example declarations and 58 declaration-style items, including vector_count_set, countComplete, switchPlayerIdentity and the well-formed-state development.
The unit contains a reusable formal state model (Player, Cell, Board, GameStatus, TicTacToeState) together with proofs about move preservation, so hard exclusion would lose formal prior art.
summary: Reviewed tic-tac-toe-lean and retain its formal game-state model and machine-checked game invariants.
